plantilla-review.descripcion: Grid card line: what [concept] is and why you recommend it, in one sentence.
plantilla-review.resumen: Detail intro: introduce [concept] and who it is useful for.
cuerpo: First body paragraph: what problem [concept] solves and in what context you use it.
Second paragraph: what makes it good and how it compares to the alternatives.
Third paragraph: nuances, limits, and who you would or would not recommend it to.
